C1 · HOW WE MEET BUDGETS · 60 S Norwood, Hillsdale
This is the reel that retires A4. Zero dollar figures, no lender.
Captions below are machine-generated. Read them before you ship.

THREE NAMES TO CLEAR
He thanks Ron and Yaacov for the referral, and Bruce,
his Home Depot account manager. Cut or keep is Shavit’s call.

DISCOUNT CLAIM
“Twenty to eighty percent off” is a claim about a third
party’s pricing. Recommend softening to “a real discount.”

SPLICE POINT
8.9s of self-correction removed here
(“not expensive... I’m sorry... not cheap... apologies”).

ENDS ON “THIS IS WHAT HAPPENS”
Needs the framing footage from C2 or IMG_4697 cut over it.
Still needs the standard end card and a music bed.
